children: Snowflake reported results for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, with product revenue of $1.49 billion (up 37% year-over-year) and total revenue of $1.55 billion (up 35% year-over-year). The company reported a GAAP operating loss of $263.0 million and non-GAAP operating income of $237.0 million, with net loss attributable to the company of $191.7 million for the quarter. Management raised full-year product revenue guidance to $6.07 billion, representing 36% year-over-year growth.
Product revenue: $1,491.9 million for Q2 FY2027, representing 37% year-over-year growth.
Total revenue: $1,546.8 million for Q2 FY2027, representing 35% year-over-year growth.
GAAP operating loss: $(263.0) million for Q2 FY2027.
Non-GAAP operating income: $237.0 million for Q2 FY2027 (15.3% non-GAAP operating margin).
Net loss attributable to Snowflake: $(191.7) million for Q2 FY2027; non-GAAP net income attributable to Snowflake: $235.3 million for the quarter.
AI adoption: CoCo exceeded ~9,100 accounts (average of last 4 weeks of the quarter) and added over 2,000 accounts in the quarter; CoWork expanded to ~5,800 accounts.

Customer expansion: 828 customers with trailing 12-month product revenue greater than $1 million (27% year-over-year growth) and 829 Forbes Global 2000 customers; added 692 net new customers in the quarter, including 14 net new Forbes Global 2000 customers.

Platform momentum: Launched over 330 product capabilities to general availability in H1 FY2027 (up 35% year-over-year), and introduced Cortex Sense and Cortex AI Gateway to extend AI from insight to action via Natoma integration.
AI customer wins and use cases: New customers highlighted include 1Password and Indeed; Sayari reported cost reductions of more than half and is using CoCo to migrate 12 billion records.
Contract visibility: Remaining performance obligations of $9.00 billion, up 30% year-over-year, indicating contracted future revenue not yet recognized (RPO excludes on-demand arrangements).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Snowflake posts Q2 FY2027 product revenue $1.49B, revenue $1.55B and raises full-year product guidance
